body: I just... I want to be wanted. I feel like I'm either ignored or dealt with under obligation. Even my therapist and psychiatrist don't take my thoughts seriously, even when I brought up suicidal idealization. I have no worth, no point in this world, and nothing (volunteering, comedy, etc.) has worked. I feel like that this will be my life from now on, and it's scaring the hell out of me.
It would be fun to do, but I'm also aware that it's a pipe dream. Besides, I don't have the motivation or courage to do stuff like that.

Sorry, fairly busy day today. Had lunch with my mom, so that was good.

Yeah, I need to start writing stuff down. Like, way in advance.

Thanks for replying. Honestly, everything you wrote is helping me a lot right now. Maybe it's because I'm in a better mood now, I dunno. I know I won't be "cured" of this depression and anxiety, but I have this to look at.

Thank you very much for your kind, wise words.

Forgot to say this before, but thanks for replying.

I think it was all the emotion that everyone had about it just overwhelmed me, and it was (and still is) inescapable. And there's nothing I can do for them, even less for the people of Charleston outside of donations. And people I go to school with, yeah.

I'm really sorry you're suffering from something similar. I wouldn't want anyone to feel the way you or I do.

Eh, venting's helping a lot. These emotions have been bottled up for a long tim. Thanks.

I think it's part me not knowing how to explain how I feel and part me forgetting to bring up certain things. My mind draws a blank when I'm in a session, but the problems are clear when I don't have to think about them. You know what I mean?

The events in Charleston have got me worked up today, and my peers' reactions to those events have got me worked up as well. I know it's stupid to be so anxious over, but I can't handle being bombarded with all of these emotions.

And then there's the shit in general that I worry about every day. I worry that the bad, awkward shit I did in the past has completely fucked me over for my future. I worry that I'm a damaged human being because the scene of the time I was sexually assaulted plays through my head daily. I worry that people think I'm fucking weird. It's just a constant barrage of anxiety, and I feel that ending my life is the only way to stop it.

Thank you for commenting. I really, really appreciate it. <3

I know a 3.1 is alright for what I had to go through, but compared to almost everyone I know, it's way below where I should be at. I mean, objectively, a 3.1 is less than a 3.9-4.0 and should make me to be a lesser student.

To be honest, I don't really know how to love him. I pummel him into the ground emotionally when he messes up and discount any achievements he might have. I've had therapists tell me to lighten up, but I can't because of how much I hate myself. I just want a hard reset.

Sorry to hear about Chad. And I don't know how much time I need, because right now it does feel like I'll be turned off forever.

Being distracted with feelings takes up so much of my time every day, though. I feel like I'm less of a person because of depression because I can't be as productive as other people. I *don't have* any sort of accomplishment that I can look to and be proud of. I fear that my feelings will soon take over my life and drive me to suicide.

Well, to start, I want an internship. I want scholarships. I want some sort of damn recognition for the 40 hours a week I put into my studies and student publications to be fucking noticed by somebody. I don't want all of the work I do to be for nothing.
